overview: Landlord recapture rights allow a landlord to terminate a commercial lease and take back possession of all or part of a, usually upon a tenant's request to sublease or assign the space. Often negotiated, these clauses enable landlords to control tenant mix, recapture space if market rents are higher, or remove a tenant who is violating terms like operating covenants.
